full_prompt_en: A square graphic spy collage sets an enormous bespectacled man's face against smaller figures and sharp blocks of red, navy, and off-white. The left half is dominated by the cropped face, whose single visible blue eye looks directly outward through thick black glasses. Red shadow cuts across the eyelid, cheek, and long nose, while fine ink-like hatch marks describe wrinkles around the mouth and jaw. Only part of the ear and white shirt collar remain inside the frame, making the close-up feel abruptly cut. Behind and to the right, a balding older man in profile wears red glasses and a dark suit. His lined face turns toward the right edge, and a dark pistol extends from his hand into the pale open area. Between the two men, a darker head and upper body recede into the layered background. Near the lower center, a dark-haired woman with a serious expression looks out from red and navy geometric shapes. Her face is much smaller than the left face, and her red clothing is interrupted by overlapping black forms. At the far right, another small female figure appears in light and dark clothing, partly isolated by white space. Across the lower portion, thin technical-looking lines and translucent rectangles cross the figures like an overprinted diagram. The background remains mostly pale, with fragments of dark structure and red vertical accents rather than a continuous setting. The lighting is graphic instead of naturalistic: cream highlights and saturated red shadow make the features dimensional, while navy silhouettes anchor the lower half. Slight print grain, rough contour strokes, and misaligned overlays keep the collage tactile. No readable title or caption appears. The overall composition builds a tense hierarchy from a giant watchful eye through several smaller agents, using hard scale shifts and restricted color to suggest intrigue.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形谍战图形拼贴把一张戴眼镜的巨大男性面孔置于较小的人物以及红色、深蓝和灰白的锐利色块之间。左半幅由被裁切的面孔主导，仅可见的一只蓝色眼睛透过厚黑眼镜直视画外。红色阴影切过眼睑、面颊与长鼻，细密如墨线的排线描绘嘴角和下颌的皱纹。耳朵和白衬衫领子只有一部分留在框内，使特写显得骤然截断。他后方偏右，一名头顶稀发的年长男子以侧面出现，戴红色眼镜，穿深色西装。布满线条的脸转向右边，手中深色手枪伸入浅色开阔区域。两名男子之间，一颗更深色的头和上身退入层叠背景。下部中央附近，一名深发、神情严肃的女子从红色与深蓝几何形中向外看。她的脸比左侧面孔小得多，红色衣服被重叠的黑色形状打断。最右侧另有一名较小的女性人物，穿浅色与深色相间的衣服，被大片白色空间部分隔开。下方，细细的技术图纸般线条和半透明矩形穿过人物，如同叠印的示意图。背景大体保持浅色，只有深色结构碎片和红色竖向重音，而没有连续的具体场景。光线呈图形化而非写实效果：奶油色亮部和饱和红影让五官有体积，深蓝剪影则锚定下半幅。轻微印刷颗粒、粗糙轮廓笔痕与错位的覆盖层使拼贴保有触感。画面没有可读的标题或说明。整体构图从巨大的警觉目光过渡到几个较小的人物，以强烈的尺度变化和受限色彩制造紧张的悬疑气氛。
style_prompt_en: The graphic collage combines emphatic drawn contours, fine hatch texture, and layered print-like color blocks. A near-white ground gives hard navy silhouettes and vermilion planes strong visibility, while small cool accents punctuate the dominant warm-cool opposition. Forms change scale abruptly, and large cropped sections press against much smaller overlapping shapes. Cream highlights, red midtones, and nearly black shadows model selected areas with poster-like economy rather than continuous photographic gradients. Some contours are clean and angular; others retain scratchy linework and slightly imperfect ink registration. Thin schematic lines and translucent rectangles cross the main masses, adding a second rhythm without replacing the primary image. Broad empty areas counterbalance densely packed focal regions. The overall effect is urgent and cinematic, using selective detail, compressed layering, and high contrast to imply movement and secrecy without relying on a fixed subject.
style_prompt_zh: 这种图形拼贴结合有力的手绘轮廓、细密排线肌理和层叠的印刷式色块。近白色底面使深蓝剪影与朱红色面十分醒目，少量冷色重音穿插在主要的冷暖对立中。形体尺度突然变化，大幅裁切区域压向小得多的重叠形状。奶油色亮部、红色中间调和近黑阴影以海报般简练的方式塑造局部，而非采用连续的摄影渐变。部分轮廓干净而有角度，另一些保留刮擦般的线条和轻微失准的油墨套印。细薄的示意线与半透明矩形穿过主要色块，形成第二层节奏，却不取代主体形象。宽阔留白平衡密集的焦点区域。整体效果急促而有电影感，选择性细节、压缩叠层与高对比暗示运动和秘密感，而不依赖固定题材。
theme_en: A graphic spy collage with a giant bespectacled face and armed figures
theme_zh: 巨大眼镜面孔与持枪人物组成的谍战图形拼贴
name: Spy movie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
